summary.text: Ryan Coleman is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 107 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Joanne Stehr (R).
He has served on the Tri-Valley School District board, representing Region 1, since 2023, with a term ending in 2027.
